lambert_W_approx.doc: Approximate the Lambert W function W(x), the solution of W·e^W = x, by Newton iteration.

params.alpha_floor: α at the SMIP domain floor

two_loop_mass_gap_candidate.returns: dict with the candidate mass gap m and how far it sits from the target

params.q: Tsallis index; q → 1 recovers the standard Lambert W

lambert_tsallis_Wq_candidate.returns: dict with W_q(z) and the comparison with the target gap

params.d_star: the d* the candidates are compared against

gap_candidates.returns: one dict per candidate expression, with its value and its distance from Ω

h_nn_eigenvalues.returns: dict with E_n = ħ_NN·(n + ½) for n < n_max

params.x_min: lower end of the x range
params.x_max: upper end of the x range

xp_spectrum_discrete.returns: dict with the sampled xp landscape

params.x: point at which to evaluate T

params.x_min: lower end of the x range
params.x_max: upper end of the x range

T_map_trajectory.returns: dict with the trajectory arrays for rendering
